rv.q: What starts out as explicit dirty talk shifts to explore fantasies and desires, then deeper into innocent hopes and fears. Chesley was a gay rights activist, and he himself died in 1990 due to AIDS related illnesses. He uses Jerker to confront the pain of the HIV/ AIDS crisis and its ravaging of loved ones until they fade into nothingness.
Chesley’s writing is remarkably assured in allowing that relationship to develop without making the shift from lust to love feel forced.
